ZYNEX-MD — textmaker commands

Every tile below was rendered by lib/logostyles.js at proof time. No network calls.

  • 59 styles
  • 9 document cards
  • 0 remote requests
  • renderer: sharp + SVG
What changed. These commands used to fetch from api.flamingtext.com, which now answers 429 to this host — and the URL it was given returned an HTML page with HTTP 200, so the bot was sending a web page to WhatsApp and calling it an image. Every logo is now drawn locally with SVG + sharp, so it either renders or it fails loudly; it can never quietly send an error page.

Franchise and platform names are themed nameplates, not the official logos. A bot that reproduced the Batman or YouTube wordmark would be passing off someone else's trademark, so .batman draws a Gotham-palette plate, .youtubelogo draws a play-icon lockup, and the caption says so on every reply.
